description: Stable error codes used across cadence runtime, sandbox, registry and verify. Codes MUST never be reused; deprecated codes are tombstoned with a replacement pointer.

missingInput.message: Required input is missing or unresolvable

policyDenied.message: Policy pack denied the requested action

sandboxViolation.message: Plugin attempted an action outside its sandbox profile

budgetExceeded.message: A declared execution budget (timeMs/tokens/externalCalls/bytes/pluginCalls) was exceeded

pluginUnavailable.message: Plugin not found in trust index or has been revoked

evidenceCorrupt.message: Evidence bundle hash chain or signature verification failed

lockMissing.message: Required tooling lock or suite closure is absent; refusing to run

replayMismatch.message: Replay produced a different result than the original run
